    Target Selection: Automatically finds the closest enemy based on distance.

    Pathfinding & Safety: Detects "voids" (holes) in the map to prevent falling and jumps over walls/obstacles automatically.

2. Visuals (Full ESP)

    Box & Name ESP: Draws a box around players and displays their names.

    Skeleton ESP: Shows the player's bone structure for better visibility through walls.

    Tracers: Draws lines from your position to the enemies.

    Team Check: Ensures that your teammates are not targeted or highlighted.

3. Combat & Aiming

    Manual Aimbot: Locks onto enemies when holding the Right Mouse Button.

    Smart Auto-Shoot: Only fires when the bot has a clear line of sight (no walls between you and the enemy).

    Heal Boost: A background loop that force-regenerates your health faster.

4. Customization

    Crosshair System: A dedicated tab to choose between 10 different styles (Dot, Sniper, Chevron, Arrow, etc.).

    Target Parts: Ability to choose where to aim (Head, Torso, or Knees).

scripts.title: Aimbot ESP SpinBot Keyless
scripts.features:
​👤 Tab: Main
​Socials & Info:
​Discord Label: Displays the community link.
​YouTube Label: Displays the channel handle.
​Copy Discord (Button): Copies the invite link to the clipboard.
​Copy YouTube (Button): Copies the channel link to the clipboard.
​👁️ Tab: Visuals
​ESP Settings:
​Enable Visuals (Toggle): Master switch for all ESP and visual features.
​Names (Toggle): Displays player usernames above their characters.
​Distance (Toggle): Displays the distance to the player in meters.
​Weapon (Toggle): Shows the tool or weapon currently equipped by the player.
​Tracers (Toggle): Draws a line from the bottom of your screen to the target.
​Chams Enemy (Toggle): Renders a silhouette of the player through walls.
​Team Check (Toggle): Prevents ESP from rendering on teammates.
​Colors:
​Hidden Player (ColorPicker): Sets the color for players behind cover/walls.
​Visible Player (ColorPicker): Sets the color for players when any body part is exposed (Visible Check).
​Limits:
​Max ESP Distance (Slider): Limits the rendering range for ESP features (50m to 5000m).
​🪲 Tab: Features
​Combat:
​Aimlock (Toggle): Automatically locks your camera onto the target.
​Predict Adjust (Slider): Adjusts aim offset based on target velocity (Bullet Prediction).
​Visible Check (Toggle): Ensures Aimlock only targets players not behind cover.
​Team Check (Toggle): Prevents Aimlock from targeting allies.
​Target Part (Dropdown): Choose hitboxes (Head, UpperTorso, or HumanoidRootPart).
​Anti-Aim / Spinbot:
​Enable Spinbot (Toggle): Activates character rotation.
​Spin Mode (Dropdown):
​None: Disabled.
​Spin Bot Walking: Visual rotation that stops when aiming or shooting.
​Spin Bot Recon: Forced rotation that continues even with weapons equipped.
​Spin Speed (Slider): Adjusts rotation velocity.
​FOV Settings:
​Show FOV Circle (Toggle): Visualizes the Aimlock's effective radius.
​FOV Radius (Slider): Increases or decreases the size of the Aimlock FOV.
​⚙️ Tab: UI Settings
​Menu Settings:
​Menu Toggle (Keybind): Assigns a key to open/hide the GUI (Default: U).
​Unload (Button): Completely removes the script and all UI elements.
​Configuration & Themes: Save/Load configs and customize the GUI color palette.
